sources.text: BUILT-IN PENCIL GROOVE WITH PENCIL LEDGE: Designed with a built-in pencil groove and 24"-wide pencil ledge for storing writing utensils and canvases; Easily set down pencils, pens, paintbrushes, and more as you work

data.draft: CONVENIENT STORAGE FEATURES: Includes a built-in pencil groove and 24"-wide pencil ledge specifically designed for storing writing utensils and canvases as you work.
